category_title: At-risk four-year-olds from low-income families with context-dependent oral language proficiency
minimal_context: The student is playing in the block center during non-teaching directed time to develop communication skills with peers and adults.
dialogue:
TUTOR: What are you doing with those blocks?

STUDENT: I am going to build a castle in the block center.

TUTOR: Give some of those blocks to your friend.

STUDENT: (To peer) If you don’t give me that toy, you’ll be sorry!

TUTOR: Listen to me and follow directions.

STUDENT: No.

options.A: Implement simultaneous stimulation of nonverbal communication from the perspective of total communication during daily center activities.
options.B: Implement instruction on boundaries and social expectations, alongside executive functioning skills like planning, decision-making, and problem-solving.
options.C: Implement focused, engaging experiences throughout the school day, during both teaching-directed and non-teaching-directed times.
options.D: Implement a communication book composed of typed conversational openers with corresponding picture communication symbols during center activities.
